abstract.text: The font attribute group gathers together attributes for determining the font within a credit or direction.
They are based on the text styles for Cascading Style Sheets. The font-family is a comma-separated list of
font names. The font-style can be normal or italic. The font-size can be one of the CSS sizes or a numeric
point size. The font-weight can be normal or bold. The default is application-dependent, but is a text font
vs. a music font.

The key type represents a key signature. Both traditional and non-traditional key signatures are supported.
The optional number attribute refers to staff numbers. If absent, the key signature applies to all staves in
the part. Key signatures appear at the start of each system unless the print-object attribute has been set to
“no”.
